blocks.text:
Free days to enjoy the beaches.

Choose a different stretch of coastline each day, swim, have lunch by the sea and spend time without a schedule. After the early departures in Rio and Iguazu, this part of the journey is deliberately relaxed.

If you prefer something more active, rent a buggy and explore the peninsula independently, stopping at scenic viewpoints. Another option is a boat trip along the bays and rocky coastline. From the water, you can see small beaches tucked between the rocks, white houses on the hillsides and stretches of coast less visible from the road.

The flexible schedule means you do not have to follow the same plan for all three days. Spend one day almost entirely by the sea, another exploring the peninsula and a third on a boat trip followed by an evening waterfront stroll. This is why Búzios has four nights in the itinerary rather than being a brief stop between excursions.

In the evening, visit the Orla Bardot promenade and Rua das Pedras. Búzios combines leisurely beach days with lively resort life after sunset.

For a particularly restful day, simply choose a bay and stay until evening. If you feel like exploring, a buggy makes it easy to visit several parts of the peninsula, while a boat trip reveals secluded beaches and rocky shores from the water. The free days can therefore be entirely relaxed or surprisingly active, without changing the main programme.

blocks.text: Búzios – Rio de Janeiro and Departure

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved Word has a Day 12 airport transfer but no separate website title for Buzios-to-Rio departure.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Rio de Janeiro Airport for your international flight home.

Over twelve days, this route takes you from a great city and Carnival to the waterfalls, then on to the peaceful Atlantic coast. Memories include the overnight Sambadrome parade, the train through the Tijuca Forest, Rio’s panoramic views, the roar of Iguazu and several carefree days in the bays of Búzios.

The first days are more energetic, with consecutive excursions and a Carnival parade lasting through the night. Iguazu also involves plenty of walking along the national park walkways. The final days in Búzios therefore offer a practical benefit beyond the beach itself: a relaxed end to the journey, without more long transfers or early excursions before returning home.
